original_failures.disposition: Independent reference checker called a custom-extension serializer absent from PyArrow's built-in FixedShapeTensorType. The corrected r2 compares built-in extension identity through schema IPC and passes; fixture values did not change.

Independent format checker expected literal Arrow list-child names. Parquet generated element where IPC used item. The corrected r2 normalizes only physical list child names and checks all 192 logical-schema/value observations.

Strict native lint flagged unnecessary raw-string hashes, a wildcard import and two oversized vector admission helpers. Production helpers were split along sparse/quantized and fixed/variable boundaries, with named imports; subsequent lint attempts are preserved.

Strict native lint found the remaining raw-string hashes plus two missing trailing semicolons in new match arms. These formatting issues were corrected; the next attempt reached a separate Python descriptor length warning.

The shared Python schema descriptor exceeded the function-length gate after adding vector kinds. Structured extension naming/metadata extraction was factored into a focused helper; native clippy r4 passed.

A hostile fabricated ResultType produced the established TypeError for an object in the type-name position. The test incorrectly expected only ValueError; r2 accepts the actual type validation error and all seven schema cases pass.
New test helper used inferred i32 in a u8 bit mask; compile refused u8 & i32. The explicit u8 mask fix exposed a second literal mismatch retained in r2.
New test helper's comparison still inferred i32 for zero after its mask became u8. Explicit 0_u8 corrected the helper; focused r3 and later focused/native coverage pass.
The validation sequence stopped at failed vectors-native-clippy-r1 after format/default lint/default tests passed. The original failed check and all logs remain.
The restarted sequence stopped at failed vectors-native-clippy-r2 after format/default lint/default tests passed. Later native lint r3/r4 and remaining current-source checks are recorded separately.

limitations: Sparse and quantized vectors are payload-only; arithmetic, quantization, dequantization and ANN remain separate work.
Text, Avro and ORC refuse these representations before producer or publication work.
Rich dictionary ingestion remains unadmitted; List and LargeList map to native List, and export retains the existing checked Int32 offset limit.
The native selected-validation grants do not account for all upstream provider allocations and do not establish an RSS bound or zero-decode claim.
